name: omaCashu
author: yaeloss
description: Lightning + Cashu (NWC) wallet for the Omarchy bar. Pays verified invoices through a local helper that keeps your wallet connection in the system keyring, with optional wallet budget reporting and hold-to-pay confirmation. Alpha.

barWidget.description: Pay Lightning invoices from the bar. NWC wallet via the omaCashu helper; every payment is reviewed and confirmed.
